description.en: One sheet of paper, three sections: writing, projects and a timeline.
description.zh: 在一张纸上画出三个栏目：文章、项目和时间线。

description.en: Try long English titles and short Chinese ones on a phone, then adjust the spacing.
description.zh: 把较长的英文标题和较短的中文标题放到手机上试排，再调整间距。

description.en: Start with a two-word post. Add a note whenever there is something worth keeping.
description.zh: 用两个英文单词写下第一篇。往后遇到值得留下的想法，就记一笔。
